name: Bowman Orchards
tagline: Apple Picking & More in Clifton Park NY
description: Bowman Orchards is an agritourism farm in 157 Sugar Hill Road, NY, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
